a: Charles Grandison Finney (1792–1875) yali munnamateeka eyafuuka omubuulizi w'enjiri, okubuulira kwe ne kuyamba okutambuza Okuzuukuka Okukulu Okwokubiri mu bitundu eby'omu bukiikakkono bwa New York n'okusukka wo. Yazaalibwa ku nsalo empya etaali nnongoose era teyayingira ttendekero lya waggulu; yasomera amateeka mu Adams, New York, era yali asuubira okumaliriza obulamu bwe mu kkooti. Ng'akkirizza nti okuzuukuka kwe kukozesa obulungi engeri Katonda z'awa so si kyamagero eky'okulindirira, yalaba ebibuga ebiramba nga bikyusibwa, era oluvannyuma n'afuuka pulezidenti wa Oberlin College.

Amateeka gaamuzzangayo bulijjo eri Bayibuli — ebitabo bya Blackstone byajulizanga Ebyawandiikibwa, era gye yeeyongeranga okusoma ekimu, n'ekirala gye kyeyongeranga okumunyigiriza. Mu ttoggo ery'omwaka 1821 okunyigirizibwa kwayitirira okugumiikirizika, okutuusa ku makya agamu bwe yakyama n'ayingira mu kibira mu bukiikakkono bw'ekyalo, ng'amaliridde obutavaayo okutuusa ng'amalirizza ensonga eyo ne Katonda. Eyo omutima gwe ogw'amalala ogw'omuwolereza w'amateeka ne gumenyeka, n'eyeewaayo eri Kristo; akawungeezi ako, mu ofiisi y'amateeka enjereere, obwa Katonda ne bumubuutikira "mu mayengo n'amayengo ag'okwagala okukulukuta."

q: Yali ategeeza ki bwe yayogera ku "kukwatibwa okuva eri Mukama"?
a: Ku makya agaddirira okukyuka kwe, omudiikoni yajja okumujjukiza omusango ogwali mu kkooti gwe yali agenda okuwolereza. Finney n'addamu nti: "Nnina okukwatibwa okuva eri Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo okuwolereza omusango gwe, era siyinza kuwolereza gugwo." Ekkooti yali emufiiriddwa emirembe gyonna; yasoma eby'obwakatonda wansi w'omusumba w'ekitundu, n'aweebwa olukusa okubuulira mu 1823–24, era n'afuluma okugenda mu nnimiro y'obuminsani ey'omu bukiikakkono bwa New York.

Lwali lukugiro olw'omu bukiikakkono bwa New York olwali lwokeddwa ennyo enkuŋŋaana z'okuzuukusa ezaddiriŋŋana, abaalaba ne balowooza nti tewali muliro gwandiddamu kukwata eyo. Wansi wa Finney ne gukwata nga bwe gutakwatanga. Mu Evans' Mills, Antwerp, Utica, Troy, ne ku nkomerero mu kuzuukuka okukulu okwa Rochester okwa 1830–31, ebibuga byakyusibwa okuva mu ntobo, nga abuulira awatali biwandiiko, ng'awakana ng'omuwolereza gwe yali abadde, era ng'anyigiriza abamuwuliriza okusalawo mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini.

q: Kiki ekyaliwo mu kuzuukuka kwa Rochester okwa 1830–31?
a: Okumala emyezi mukaaga Finney yabuulira kumpi buli lunaku eri abantu abakulu ab'ekibuga ekyali kigaggawala ku mugga ogusimibwa — abawolereza b'amateeka, abasuubuzi, n'ab'omu maka gaabwe — era empisa z'ekibuga kyonna ne zikyuka. Amaduuka g'omwenge ne gaggalwa, enkaayana ne zitereezebwa, era okuzuukuka ne kubuna nga kugoberera Erie Canal okuyingira ekibuga oluvannyuma lw'ekirala. Ab'omu kiseera ekyo baabala abaakyuka mu bikumi mu kitundu ekyo era ne bakkiriza nti okusaasaana kwakwatako obukumi bw'abantu; ekyo kyafuula Finney omuzuukusa asinga okwatiikirira mu Amerika.

Okuleeta abantu ku kusalawo, Finney yatandikawo ebyo abanenya bye baayita "new measures": enkuŋŋaana ez'ekiro ezaawanvuyanga ennaku n'ennaku, okubuulira okw'olwatu okutaategekebwa, okuyita amannya g'abantu mu lwatu mu kusaba, abakazi okusaba mu nkuŋŋaana omuli abasajja n'abakazi, n'"anxious seat" — akatebe ak'omu maaso abo abaali bazuukusiddwa we baatuulanga mu lwatu, nga tebakyasobola kwekweka. Ebyo kaakano bya bulijjo; mu myaka gya 1820 byeewuunyisa nnyo abakulembeze b'amakanisa agaali gasimbiddwawo dda.

Yali akakasa nti okuzuukuka si kyamagero ekirindirirwa obutakolako kintu, wabula kibala ky'engeri eza bulijjo bwe zikozesebwa obulungi — era nti abantu aba bulijjo, nga bakwatiddwa omusango olw'ekibi, kibagwanira okusalawo. "Okuzuukuka tekiri kirala wabula ntandikwa mpya ey'okugondera Katonda," bwe yawandiika, era mu bigambo ebisingawo obutereevu: "Eddiini kye kintu omuntu ky'alina okukola." Ng'amaze okukikola ye yennyini mu kibira ku makya ag'omu ttoggo, yamala emyaka ataano ng'ayita abalala okukola bwe batyo.

Finney teyakkirizanga nti amaanyi gaali mu ngeri ezo, wadde mu kubuulira kwe ye; emirundi n'emirundi yagakomyawo ku kwegayiririra abalala okwakolebwanga mu kyama. "Kitaffe" Daniel Nash yatuukanga mu kibuga wiiki nnyingi nga Finney tannatuuka, ne yeewaayo kumpi kyenkanyi mu kusaba okw'okulumwa ennyo nga Finney abuulira; mu Rochester, Abel Clary yali azitoowereddwa nnyo olw'emmeeme n'asabira ku ttaka, nga tasobola kugolokoka. Finney yalowooza nti okuzuukuka kwalinnyanga ne kukka wamu n'omulimu guno ogutalabika, era Nash bwe yafiira ku maviivi ge, omulimu gwa Finney ogw'okutambulatambula nagwo ne gutera okukoma.

q: Kiki ekyaliwo mu kkolero lya ppamba ery'e Whitesboro?
a: Ng'atambula ku makya agamu mu kkolero lya Mr. Wolcott, Finney yayita ku muwala eyali ku kyuma ng'awuguma, ekitundu ng'aduula, eri munne. Emikono gye ne gitandika okukankana n'atasobola kuddaabiriza wuzi eyali ekutuse; yasembera nga waliwo bugazi butono, n'amutunuulira butunuuzi, ye n'agwa wansi n'akaaba amaziga. Omusango ne gukka ku lunyiriri lwonna, abakozi ne bakaabira ku byuma byabwe, era nannyini kkolero eyali tannakyuka n'alagira nti: "Muyimirize ekkolero, abantu bafeeyo ku by'eddiini." Mu nnaku ntono kumpi ekkolero lyonna ne likyusibwa.

q: Kuziyizibwa ki kwe yasanga, era kiki kye yaleka?
a: Amaanyi g'ezo "new measures" n'okubuulira kwe okw'olwatu byatiisa abakulembeze b'eddiini mu New England; Asahel Nettleton ne Lyman Beecher ne beeteekawo okumuwakanya, ne bamusisinkana mu New Lebanon Convention mu 1827, era abayivu b'eby'obwakatonda aba Old School ne bawaayiriza nti okussa kwe essira ku busobozi bw'omuntu kwali kuwaanyisizza ekisa kya Katonda eky'obwakabaka n'akiwa bukodyo bwereere. Yabeera wansi w'okuvunaanibwa okwo obulamu bwe bwonna. Ng'omulwanyi ow'amaanyi ow'okumalawo obuddu eyagaana abalina abaddu okusemberera Emmeeza ya Mukama, yaweereza nga pulezidenti wa Oberlin, era Lectures on Revivals of Religion ge (1835) gaakola engeri ekkanisa gye yandisabidde ku by'okuzuukuka okumala emirembe mingi.
